title: Man Sitting in Lake, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot from September 1956 depicting a man seated on a rock surrounded by shallow lake water. He rests his head thoughtfully on his hand with a subtle smile. Calm water and distant hills form the background horizon, reflecting the late summer sky. The print features classic deckled edges and a side margin date stamp reading 'SEP 56'.
